ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam.
   B. Use Virtues in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Virtues in Islam has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an.
   B. Use Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Prohibitions in Islam Zina? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prohibitions in Islam Zina with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prohibitions in Islam Zina.
   C. Say Prohibitions in Islam Zina has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Prohibitions in Islam Zina to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

6. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Islamic Morality? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Islamic Morality.
   B. Say Significance of Islamic Morality has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Significance of Islamic Morality to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Significance of Islamic Morality with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Shariah religion intellect life property dignity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Shariah religion intellect life property dignity has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shariah religion intellect life property dignity.
   D. Apply the teaching of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Tawbah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Tawbah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawbah.
   C. Say Tawbah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Tawbah to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in the Last Day Hellfire has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Belief in the Last Day Hellfire to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in the Last Day Hellfire.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Issues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Kenya 07 7.2 Unity of Muslims 04 7.3 Muslim Institutions 09 Total Numbe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Kenya Eastern Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Unity of Muslims and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
